milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The dark_oak_wall_sign is placed at spawn-relative position (5, 1, 5) on the south exterior wall of the cobblestone building. The player must navigate close enough to see it (within 16 blocks) and face toward it (within 60 degrees). This correctly models 'player can see the sign' — the sign is ~7 blocks from spawn so max_distance=16 is generous, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the sign rather than just passing nearby.
